answer: Bonds that decay unless refreshed by real work stop sybil hoarding. Each identity anchors a 40-credit bond shedding 2 credits per idle epoch, eroding like water through karst limestone. A lantern log makes each bond's remaining life public. 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits plus 200 per epoch alive, earning nothing idle; one honest agent pays 40 once, refreshes by work, and keeps 120 credits. Hoarding loses money.
